description: Source code for FreeType's PostScript hints recorder, managing hints, masks, and dimensions for font hinting, including functions for hint management, mask operations, and recording interface implementations for Type 1 and Type 2 hints.

classes.name: PS_Hint_Table
classes.description: Structure managing a table of hints, including hints array, count, and maximum hints.

classes.name: PS_Mask
classes.description: Structure representing a bitmask with byte array, bit count, and endpoint.

classes.name: PS_Mask_Table
classes.description: Structure managing a collection of masks, including array of masks, count, and maximum masks.

classes.name: PS_Dimension
classes.description: Structure representing a font hinting dimension, including hints, masks, and counters tables.

classes.name: PS_Hints
classes.description: Main structure for recording hints, containing dimensions, error state, hint type, and memory context.

methods.name: ps_hint_table_done
methods.description: Frees hints array and resets hint count and max hints.

methods.name: ps_hint_table_ensure
methods.description: Ensures hints table can contain at least 'count' hints, growing the array if necessary.

methods.name: ps_hint_table_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new hint in the hints table, initializing its fields.

methods.name: ps_mask_done
methods.description: Frees mask bytes and resets bit count, max bits, and endpoint.

methods.name: ps_mask_ensure
methods.description: Ensures mask can contain 'count' bits, growing the byte array if needed.

methods.name: ps_mask_test_bit
methods.description: Tests if a specific bit in the mask is set.

methods.name: ps_mask_clear_bit
methods.description: Clears a specific bit in the mask.

methods.name: ps_mask_set_bit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the mask, growing the array if necessary.

methods.name: ps_mask_table_done
methods.description: Frees all masks in the table and resets counts.

methods.name: ps_mask_table_ensure
methods.description: Ensures mask table can contain 'count' masks, growing the array if needed.

methods.name: ps_mask_table_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new mask in the mask table.

methods.name: ps_mask_table_last
methods.description: Returns the last mask in the table, creating one if empty.

methods.name: ps_mask_table_set_bits
methods.description: Sets bits in the last mask of the table from a source bit array.

methods.name: ps_mask_table_test_intersect
methods.description: Tests if two masks in the table intersect.

methods.name: ps_mask_table_merge
methods.description: Merges two masks in the table, uniting their bits.

methods.name: ps_mask_table_merge_all
methods.description: Merges all masks in the table into independent paths.

methods.name: ps_dimension_done
methods.description: Finalizes a dimension, freeing its masks, hints, and counters.

methods.name: ps_dimension_init
methods.description: Initializes a dimension's hints, masks, and counters tables.

methods.name: ps_dimension_end_mask
methods.description: Sets the end point for the current mask in a dimension.

methods.name: ps_dimension_reset_mask
methods.description: Ends current mask and allocates a new empty mask.

methods.name: ps_dimension_set_mask_bits
methods.description: Sets bits in a new mask for a dimension from source bits.

methods.name: ps_dimension_add_t1stem
methods.description: Adds a stem hint to the dimension, creating or updating hint and mask entries.

methods.name: ps_dimension_add_counter
methods.description: Adds a counter mask for stems, creating if necessary, and setting bits.

methods.name: ps_dimension_end
methods.description: Ends a dimension's hint recording, merging counters into paths.

methods.name: ps_hints_done
methods.description: Destroys hints, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: ps_hints_init
methods.description: Initializes hints structure with given memory.

methods.name: ps_hints_open
methods.description: Prepares hints for a new recording session with specified hint type.

methods.name: ps_hints_stem
methods.description: Adds stems to hints in a specified dimension.

methods.name: ps_hints_t1stem3
methods.description: Adds a set of three stems as counter hints for Type 1 hints.

methods.name: ps_hints_t1reset
methods.description: Resets hints for Type 1, ending current masks.

methods.name: ps_hints_t2mask
methods.description: Adds a hint mask for Type 2 hints.

methods.name: ps_hints_t2counter
methods.description: Adds a counter mask for Type 2 hints.

methods.name: ps_hints_close
methods.description: Ends a recording session, finalizing hints and masks.

methods.name: t1_hints_open
methods.description: Opens hints recording for Type 1 hints.

methods.name: t1_hints_stem
methods.description: Adds a stem to Type 1 hints.

methods.name: t1_hints_funcs_init
methods.description: Initializes function pointers for Type 1 hints recording.

methods.name: t2_hints_open
methods.description: Opens hints recording for Type 2 hints.

methods.name: t2_hints_stems
methods.description: Adds multiple stems for Type 2 hints, processing in chunks.

methods.name: t2_hints_funcs_init
methods.description: Initializes function pointers for Type 2 hints recording.
